Cost: 1,750eb (Very Expensive)
Class: EQ Medium Pistol
Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Auto-Compensator, Extended Magazine, Efficient Autosear, Pistol Autosear, Rubber Grip (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Proprietary Armor-Piercing ammo costs 50eb (Costly) per 10 and only fits this weapon. Autofire uses 6 rounds, not 10 (Efficient Autosear). Against targets within 50m/yds, reduce any total attack penalty by 1 (Rubber Grip).

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
